ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a straightforward content-generation/transactional task (writing a job description), and Dunlin holds a clear capability advantage on the relevant dimensions — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), IFEval/instruction-following (89.8 vs 85.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4). Since the user is frustrated and explicitly wants a better, more usable result this time, instruction-following and output quality matter most, and Dunlin is stronger there. The two models' task preferences for neutral transactional requests are nearly identical (50 vs 49), so preference wasn't a deciding factor — capability was.
